title: Vendored cloud/sandbox docs still point at cloud/factory paths the move renamed
body: cloud/sandbox/README.md, common.sh and worker.sh reference cloud/factory/src/... for the control-plane files they describe. Those trees are digest-pinned to ticks here (internal/sandboxpin), so the l9n move could not edit them: the references are stale in this repository until Phase 4 item 4 moves the image context and the pin is re-synced from ticks. Fold the doc alignment into item 4's pin bump rather than editing a vendored tree.
